title: Sleep study (polysomnography)
what: While you sleep at night, your breathing, blood oxygen, pulse, brain activity, and movements are recorded. Sensors are stuck on your body. No needles.
why: For loud snoring with pauses in breathing, strong daytime sleepiness, insomnia, or strange behavior during sleep.
duration: one night, usually from evening to morning
tell_doctor: What medicines you take, especially sleeping pills and sedatives
If you already have a breathing machine for sleep

prepare.title: During the day
prepare.text: Do not nap during the day. After lunch, no coffee, strong tea, or energy drinks.

prepare.title: Alcohol
prepare.text: No alcohol on the day of the study.

prepare.title: Your body
prepare.text: Wash your hair. Do not use hairspray, gel, or cream on your face and skin. Men should shave. If you have a beard, check with your clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Take your usual medicines as normal, unless your doctor said otherwise.

bring: Your own pillow, if you sleep better with it
A toothbrush and things for the morning
steps: In the evening, you are taken to your room
A nurse sticks sensors on your head, face, chest, and legs
A thin tube is placed under your nose and an oxygen sensor on your finger
You go to sleep as usual and the lights are turned off
During the night, a nurse watches the recording by camera
In the morning, the sensors are removed
feel: The sensors feel unusual, but they do not hurt
Many people worry they will not fall asleep. Usually there is enough sleep for a result
If you need the toilet, call the nurse and they will unhook you
after: You can go home right away in the morning
Leftover glue washes off with water
Results usually take a few days. Your doctor will go over them

faq.q: Can I do a sleep study at home?
faq.a: Yes, there are home devices to check for sleep apnea. But they record less. Your doctor will decide what suits you.

faq.q: What if I cannot fall asleep at the clinic?
faq.a: Almost everyone falls asleep. A few hours of sleep is usually enough for a result.

reminders.text: Sleep study today. No napping, no coffee after lunch, and no alcohol.
Pack your pajamas, evening medicines, and things for the morning.
